implementation_steps: Freeze one exact source/head/tree and actual prospective merge tuple.
Collect the complete registered workflow set and nonempty jobs; classify deterministic failures before rerun.
Download and hash every required artifact; record producer run/attempt/job and revalidate after metadata edits.

implementation_steps: Read effective branch protection and rulesets with administrator-scoped access.
Compare direct/force/delete, aggregate freshness, CODEOWNER/latest-push/conversation and bypass configuration with desired policy.
Run an approved harmless negative admission rehearsal; preserve before/after responses.

external_obligations: Actual administration capability and independent no-bypass acceptance; repository metadata admin=true is insufficient.

implementation_steps: Keep the current main-target integration line singular; stack focused development children without force-updating others.
Replace stale PR-body source/tree/merge/failure summaries with current API observations.
Reconcile historical PR #63-specific acceptance semantics through a reviewed plan change rather than a status-only override.

external_obligations: Fresh non-author approval and ordinary protected admission.

implementation_steps: Preserve full scope, immutable backlog and accepted-evidence gate semantics.
Make source observations, mutable status, proposed design depth and independent acceptance separate fields.
Rebind obsolete candidate-specific milestone semantics and their digest in one explicitly reviewed change; do not merely relabel old evidence.
required_checks: Plan, status-transition, scope-shrink and documentation regression tests.
external_obligations: Independent governance acceptance; a locally consistent JSON snapshot is not a real-world fact.

implementation_steps: Complete one small end-to-end retained evidence admission before expanding control machinery.

Run the shared evidence_admission consumers; retain limitations, expiry and review provenance.

implementation_steps: Publish the authoritative migration table/column/constraint/index dictionary and adapter ownership mapping.
Verify both database catalogs against the same declared logical invariants with profile-specific SQL.
Rehearse fresh-target restore, receipt/event/outbox integrity, migration resume and rollback barriers.

implementation_steps: Move service request/result and repository contracts out of the concrete PostgreSQL adapter; keep one composition root.
Close a PostgreSQL-first official-client authentication/session/storage vertical slice without counting custom authority endpoints as Nakama parity.
Bind one deadline/cancellation tree through ingress, service, transaction, receipt and outbox; specify readiness and bounded signal/drain behavior.
Repeat the accepted bounded slice on CockroachDB before granting that profile or full-foundation closure.

external_obligations: Protocol, database, security and SRE review; both-profile obligations in the existing gap remain unchanged.

implementation_steps: Trace all key copies from configuration to provider/cache/drop; document zeroization, crash-dump and secret-provider limitations.

Implement and test durable key rotation/revoke propagation, unknown-epoch refusal and response-loss reconciliation.
required_checks: Native vectors, malformed/fuzz/timing corpus, domain confusion and provider failure/rotation tests.
external_obligations: Qualified independent security/cryptography review and real production provider/custody evidence.

implementation_steps: Preserve full-width signature-length checks and strict 32-byte HS256 acceptance.
Keep both argument orders and 256-byte deltas in the hostile corpus.
Distinguish retained compatibility code from the actual active provider call path.

implementation_steps: Specify pending/leased/applied/dead-letter/indeterminate transitions and mutation-on-error behavior.
Bind every apply/reclaim/ack to exact owner, lease generation and authority generation.
Give every external effect adapter a stable idempotency key, outcome query, quarantine and reconciliation contract.

required_checks: Native/property/model tests plus both-profile transaction and provider-ambiguity fault packets.
external_obligations: Independent data-integrity review and real adapter outcome evidence.

implementation_steps: Maintain repository identity consistently in active Go module, source and document references.
Classify historical names as immutable history only.
Document each Go package responsibility and its Rust migration/rollback destination.
required_checks: Go module resolution, test/race/vet and active-reference checks.
external_obligations: Independent governance acceptance of identity boundaries.

implementation_steps: Preserve explicit required-live flags and fail on absent URL, image, profile or zero discovered cases.
Keep developer opt-outs no-credit and visibly separate from mandatory CI.
Bind both profile results to source and prospective objects with nonempty assertions.
required_checks: Missing-environment and zero-test negative cases; actual PostgreSQL/CockroachDB runs.
external_obligations: Independent compatibility-QA acceptance of retained results.

implementation_steps: Complete the ACL/OCC/batch error-precedence matrix and exact value-byte/public-version contract.
Add public HTTP/gRPC mapping and an authenticated opaque cursor with actor/owner/collection/project/profile binding.

Keep SHA-256 corruption detection distinct from MD5 public OCC and from authenticity.

implementation_steps: Measure total elapsed request budget across pool acquire, lock/statement, retry delay and cancellation transport.
Preserve cancelled-backend retirement and exact receipt reconciliation for ambiguous commits.
Prove certificate rotation/reload and profile-specific serializable retry, churn and failover.
Measure saturation, tail latency, connection/memory growth and recovery on declared hardware/workload.
required_checks: Live TLS negatives, deadline/cancellation, retry, fault, performance and recovery packets per profile.

Bind owner/task/test/profile and classify native hardening differences without shrinking mandatory scope.

implementation_steps: Classify every non-main ref with exact tip/tree, PR relationship and reachability.
Preserve active heads, evidence archives and sole unmerged work.
Execute only approved reachable cleanup after retaining immutable before-state, then compare after-state.

implementation_steps: Refresh reviewer conflicts and qualification against the actual current candidate, not predecessor PR #63.

operational_exit_detail: Measure full-state clone costs and lock/allocation/tail-latency behavior under maximum admitted cardinality.
Bound refresh history, revocation high-water, receipts and audit retention without forgetting still-valid replay protection.
Prove namespace/epoch/checkpoint rollover under realistic churn using rolling cohorts rather than assuming all production connections can stop at once.
Execute fresh-target backup/PITR, multi-node authority/route/outbox fencing, rolling upgrade and measured RPO/RTO.
Run actual 24h/72h/7d profiles; no synthetic or segmented metadata may replace missing elapsed execution.
Shadow without effects, use exclusive canary ownership, preserve rollback barriers and obtain release/support/cutover/retirement acceptance.
closure_rule: Only existing gap/evidence/gate validators and independently accepted exact-object facts can close gaps. This detail file creates no statuses, credentials, reviewer identities or product claims.
